title: Limitations.
bodyText: Nothing contained in this chapter shall be construed to limit or prohibit the acquisition of evidence or information by an investigating committee by any lawful means not provided for herein.
bodyHtml: §21-19  Limitations.  Nothing contained in this chapter shall be construed to limit or prohibit the acquisition of evidence or information by an investigating committee by any lawful means not provided for herein. [L 1969, c 211, pt of §1]
